subject: Can we use R-inla for predictions on stream networks?

messages.author: 02c67c63c0b97e41
messages.subject: Can we use R-inla for predictions on stream networks?
parts:
Hello all,


I am trying to build habitat suitability models for two co-existing freshwater fishes which compete for space. I am new to R-inla and am not very sure about a few technical details, requesting any suggestions on the following:


1) Is it genuine to build a mesh on a catchment and then crop the results on the river raster to show the predictions on the river networks specifically (eliminating the land areas, which are not of interest to my study)?


2) Also, what way can I use R-inla to produce stream-based interpolations and not the catchment scale, as is done in packages like SSN? Would you suggest that using R-inla for stream networks might not be a correct decision?


Thanks,


Aashna
